name: grad-marketing-pack
description: 31 Claude Skills for doing the junior marketing job well with Claude and then showing it, from first brief to first job: a brand voice guide, reusable prompt briefs, a line-by-line review of every AI draft and a substantiation check on every claim; audience personas, a jobs-to-be-done map, a competitor content audit and a sourced SWOT; a creative brief, a messaging house, a campaign plan, a See Think Do Care plan and a launch checklist; a content calendar, social posts, short video scripts, email newsletters, landing page copy and SEO content briefs in the brand voice; a metrics readout in plain words, a monthly report with the bottom line first and an A/B test plan with the decision rule written first; then a proof project on a real brand, a portfolio case study, an honest note on how you used AI and a portfolio post; plus a job ad decoder, a marketing CV, a cover letter, take-home task prep and interview practice. For marketing graduates, final-year marketing students and graduate marketing executives. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template, a finish line and the next skill to run.
